outcome: knowledge of antenatal and postnatal exercises
practice of antenatal and postnatal exercise
cohort: 130 pregnant women without risk factors from rural areas in and around Thandalam attending Saveetha Medical College Obstetrics & Gynaecology department.
finding: The majority of rural women lacked information about exercises during pregnancy, highlighting the need for improved awareness and promotion of health-enhancing physical activity by healthcare professionals.
